description.zh:
媒资ID，即音/视频ID（VideoId）。多个ID之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔，最多支持20个。可通过以下方式获取：

- 通过控制台上传的音/视频，可登录点播控制台，选择媒资库 > 音/视频查看音/视频ID。
- 通过获取音视频上传地址和凭证接口获取上传地址和凭证时，为返回参数VideoId的值。
- 音/视频上传后，可通过搜索媒体信息接口查询，为请求后返回参数VideoId的值。
description.en:
The ID of the media asset, which is the audio or video ID (VideoId). Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 20 IDs. You can obtain the ID in one of the following ways:

- For audio or video files uploaded in the console, log on to the VOD console and choose Media Assets > Audio/Video to view the audio or video ID.

- The value of the VideoId parameter that is returned after you call the operation to obtain an upload URL and credential.

- The value of the VideoId parameter that is returned after you call the SearchMedia operation.

description.zh: 自定义 ID 列表。由一个或多个自定义 ID 组成，多个 ID 之间使用半角逗号（,）分隔。最多支持 20 个。
description.en: A list of custom IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). You can specify up to 20 IDs.

descriptions.zh:
- 一次最多获取20个音视频的信息。
- 音视频上传完成后，点播会对上传完成的音视频源文件进行分析，因此媒资信息是异步生成的。可通过设置[音视频分析完成](~~99935~~)的[事件通知](~~55627~~)，当接收到[音视频分析完成](~~99935~~)的事件通知后，再调用本接口获取音视频信息。
descriptions.en:
- You can retrieve information for up to 20 audio or video files in a single request.

- The media asset information is generated asynchronously because Video on Demand (VOD) analyzes the source file after it is uploaded. You can configure [event notifications](~~55627~~) for [Audio/Video Analysis Complete](~~99935~~). After you receive the notification, call this operation to retrieve the audio or video information.
